svg.aria-label: The seven orders of growth (1, log₂ N, N, N log₂ N, N², N³, 2ᴺ) on two plots. Left, linear axes, N up to 40: 2ᴺ, N³ and N² leave the frame while the slower classes hug the floor. Right, log-log axes, N up to 1024: each power law is a straight line whose slope is its exponent (1, 2, 3); log₂ N flattens, and 2ᴺ bends upward out of the frame.
